raw_segments.text: To mingle friendship far is mingling bloods. I have tremor cordies on me. My heart dances,
but not for joy, not joy. This entertainment may a free face put on, derive a liberty
from hardiness, from bounty, fertile bosom, and well become the agent.
T'may, I grant, but to be paddling palms and pinching fingers, as now they are, and
making practiced smiles as in a looking-glass, and then to sigh, as twear the Mort O, T-H,
O, that is entertainment my bosom likes not, nor my brows. Mamilius, art thou my boy.
